about.title: About
about.quote1: Real transformation begins when you can read both the person and the system together.
about.intro: CCT was founded in 2016 by Nurhan Yazganel to address individual and organizational development holistically—without fragmenting it—and to create long-term, lasting value.
about.focus: Since our founding, our focus has been clear: to design development models that turn awareness into behavior and potential into sustainable impact.
about.today: In today's business world, producing results alone is not enough. Speed, uncertainty, and increasing competition push organizations to become more agile, more conscious, and more human-centered. The structures that endure are those that strengthen people, develop leadership capacity, and make learning part of the culture.
about.real: Because real transformation starts with people, not systems.
about.holistic: At CCT we do not limit development to training or coaching. We read the person, the team, and the system together. We treat coaching, training, mentoring, consulting, and facilitation not as separate services but as one integrated impact model.
about.noShelf: At CCT, no program comes off the shelf.
about.everyProgram: Every program starts with a deep discovery of need. It is then designed from scratch around the organization's culture, goals, dynamics, and real business challenges. We offer development journeys that are living, flexible, and shaped by reality in the field—not standard content.
about.because: Because we know: one-size-fits-all solutions produce temporary results; tailored design creates lasting transformation. So we aim not only for knowledge transfer but for behavior change, application, performance improvement, and measurable impact. We define success by concrete results in the field, not short-term satisfaction.
about.mission: To design development journeys that read people and systems together; unite training, coaching, mentoring, consulting, and facilitation in one integrated impact model; and create unique, goal-oriented, lasting transformation for every organization and individual.
about.journey1: Structures that draw on the dynamics of the organization, team, and individual
about.quote2: Real transformation is possible not with one-size-fits-all solutions, but with a holistic approach at the right moment.
about.different: Many organizations today offer training, coaching, mentoring, or consulting separately. What makes CCT different and strong is a holistic view that can see these disciplines together and use the right approach in the right place. Behind this approach is not only theory but deep experience gained in the field.
about.founderIntro: The disciplined leadership background of Nurhan Yazganel, founder and director of CCT, her ICF Master Certified Coach (MCC) expertise, and her long-standing experience in training and coaching form the most distinctive strength of CCT programs. Thus every program is unique in both content and the way it is delivered.
about.why1: Because we don't offer ready-made solutions. We discover real need, ask the right questions, and design for the organization.
about.why2: Because we don't just create awareness. We change ways of working and create impact.
about.why3: Because we don't just talk about development. We bring it to life.
about.why4: At CCT, every journey blends coaching, mentoring, consulting, facilitation, and training. That is why our journeys leave lasting impact and measurable results.

founder.title: Nurhan YAZGANEL
founder.quote: 'Love yourself, believe in yourself, and make a difference.'
founder.bio: Nurhan Yazganel is a development leader who approaches individual and organizational development not only as a performance lever but as a holistic transformation process that turns awareness into lasting impact. As founder and director of CCT, she is also among the few professionals worldwide to hold the Master Certified Coach (MCC) credential, the highest level awarded by the International Coaching Federation (ICF).
founder.bio2: Nurhan Yazganel graduated from the Naval Academy in 1996 and is Turkey's first female active-duty naval officer. This pioneering experience became one of the cornerstones of her leadership approach. After her degree in Computer and Control Engineering, she completed postgraduate studies in Business Administration, International Relations, and Public Administration. She served in various roles within the Naval Forces Command for 21 years, led numerous teams and systems, and retired with the rank of Major.
founder.bio3: After her military career, Yazganel turned to human development and stepped into coaching and training through a rigorous learning journey. In her second career she has delivered coaching and training to thousands of participants across more than 200 local and international organizations, focusing on combining coaching and training to bring speed and impact to the transformation of ways of working. She has over 8,000 hours of experience in executive, leadership, team, and performance coaching. In 2016 she founded Core Coaching & Training (CCT) and has since deepened her professional path in this field.
founder.bio4: Nurhan Yazganel is not only a coach who coaches and mentors; she is also a master coach who develops other coaches and contributes to the advancement of the profession. In this capacity she led the establishment of PDRICMA (PDR International Coaching and Mentoring Academy), one of Turkey's prestigious coaching schools, in 2020, and served as its Dean from 2020 to 2026. In doing so she has taken coaching beyond individual expertise and stands out as one of the rare figures contributing to the sustainable development of the profession. She continues her work through CCT, the company she founded.
founder.bio5: Believing that each person is unique, and viewing life from a holistic perspective, Yazganel has made it her mission to stand by people as they discover their potential, make a difference, and become the leaders of their own lives. The words that best describe her outlook on life are Passion, Curiosity, and Love.

coachingArea.title: Coaching Programs
descriptions: Transforming the performance of top-level executives in their strategic roles into an organizational leverage effect, beyond their individual potential.

One of the most important approaches that makes CCT different and powerful is offering training and team coaching within the same development journey as an integrated model. This approach is a unique impact model developed by CCT and applied only at CCT.

The core purpose of the Executive Coaching program is to maximize managers' leadership capacities in full alignment with organizational goals and prepare them for future senior roles. This program is a holistic leadership development program that aims not only for managers to acquire knowledge, but to experience behavioral transformation in real work environments.
Enabling individuals to gain awareness in their professional journeys and equipping them with the ability to take the wheel of their own careers.
Enabling individuals to recognize the critical competencies needed for professional success, activate their development potential, and transform these into lasting behavioral habits.
Accelerating the transition of the organization's most valuable talents from current expertise roles to strategic leadership roles and making this transition seamless.
Enabling executive candidates or current leaders to demonstrate their true potential at the highest level in professional assessment centers.
Ensuring professional coaches demonstrate the 8 Core Competencies defined by ICF at the highest level and guiding them through the credentialing process.

details.intro: Designed to manage the complexity, high responsibility, and strategic loneliness that comes with leadership at the top, this program aims to maximize both the leader's professional competencies and personal integrity.
bullets: Strategic Vision & Agility: Enabling the leader to step out of daily operational cycles to focus on long-term strategies; strengthening rapid and accurate decision-making in times of uncertainty.
Influence & Impact Management: Building a trust-based, persuasive, and inspiring leadership presence (Executive Presence) beyond hierarchical power.
Corporate Culture & Succession: Enabling the leader to become a role model who embodies corporate values; guiding talent management and succession planning processes.
Cognitive & Emotional Resilience: Sustaining the leader's mental clarity and psychological resilience by maintaining emotional intelligence under high stress and pressure.

details.intro: In many organizations, training and coaching are conducted independently. Training produces knowledge; coaching focuses on behavior. However, when these two areas progress disconnected from each other, the reflection of learned knowledge to the field and daily work practices remains limited. CCT's Beyond Team Coaching model eliminates this disconnect. In this special program; targeted and precise training content is designed according to the team's needs, knowledge gained in training is transformed into behavior through team coaching and mentoring approaches, and the learning process proceeds through the team's real cases and daily work dynamics. Thus, knowledge does not remain as an abstract gain; it directly reflects on the team's decision-making, communication, collaboration, and performance practices.
bullets: Common Goals & Strategic Alignment: Ensuring team members are fully aligned with the organization's main strategies; transforming 'me'-focused approaches into 'we'-focused collective success consciousness.
Psychological Safety & Interaction Culture: Building a trust-based interaction environment where open communication is supported and different ideas are seen not as conflict elements but as richness.
Collective Accountability & Responsibility: Developing a 'responsibility consciousness' independent of hierarchy, where success and failure are jointly owned by the team.
Agility & Decision-Making Dynamics: Increasing the team's adaptation capability in complex and uncertain environments; maximizing implementation speed through transparent decision-making.
Conflict Management & Constructive Discussion: Eliminating hidden agendas and unproductive conflicts within the team, redirecting this energy toward innovation and solution generation.

details.intro: In this program, in addition to the standard executive coaching approach, mentoring, training, and consulting are integrated. This serves as a catalyst enabling managers to go beyond their technical expertise, strengthen contemporary management and leadership competencies, adopt a leadership presence, posture and mindset, and master people management, strategic influence, and emotional maturity. Visible transformations occur in awareness, development, and ways of working across all competencies.
bullets: Strengthening Leadership Identity: Enabling managers to recognize their leadership style, polishing their strengths while developing strategies to turn development areas into an organizational advantage.
Performance & Results Focus: Increasing efficiency in complex project management, developing delegation skills to elevate team performance, and focusing on clear business results.

Effective Communication & Relationship Management: Developing the ability to build bridges between departments and stakeholders; elevating conflict management and persuasion skills to a professional level.

Career Transition & Adaptation: Facilitating newly appointed or promoted managers to quickly adapt to expectations in their new roles and minimizing the growing pains of transitioning from 'being managed' to 'managing'.

Self-Awareness & Emotional Intelligence: Enabling managers to understand their own triggers, maintaining rationality even under stress and enhancing the ability to motivate those around them through empathy.

details.intro: Aims to crystallize the individual's strengths, values, and development areas, offering strategic and sustainable career navigation aligned with market dynamics.
bullets: Self-Discovery & Competency Inventory: Enabling individuals to discover their core talents and their 'unique value proposition' that sets them apart.
Career Vision & Goal Setting: Structuring short and long-term career goals according to SMART criteria, transforming uncertainty into a concrete roadmap.
Career Transitions & Change Management: Guiding individuals to maintain mental resilience at critical junctures and turn transitions into strategic opportunities.
Market Positioning & Branding: Rebuilding resume, LinkedIn profile, and interview performance as a 'professional brand' aligned with target positions.
Work-Life Balance & Purpose: Designing career success in an integrated way with the individual's life values and happiness.

details.intro: Aims to close the gap between 'knowing' and 'being able to do' with an action-oriented development plan.
bullets: Competency Analysis & Awareness: Analyzing the individual's current competency level and identifying the areas with the highest leverage effect.
Personalized Development Roadmap: Creating a strategic plan that converts abstract goals into concrete, measurable micro-goals.
Stretching the Comfort Zone: Rehearsing new skills in a safe environment and applying them in real business scenarios.
Cognitive & Behavioral Transformation: Identifying mental barriers to competency and developing behavior at an internalized reflex level.
Sustainable Performance Improvement: Tracking the reflection of developed competencies on business results and establishing mechanisms for lasting change.

details.intro: Aims to equip participants with the mental and behavioral competencies to transform individual achievements into team success and view the corporate vision from a broader perspective.
bullets: From Individual Expertise to Leadership Identity: Achieving the mental transformation from being 'the best doer' to 'the leader who ensures the best is done'.
Strategic Perspective & Big Picture: Developing the muscles of understanding long-term goals and strategic decision-making instead of getting lost in operational details.
Influence & Stakeholder Management: Demonstrating a strong 'Leadership Presence' through persuasion ability and effective communication beyond hierarchical power.
Emotional Intelligence & Resilience: Coping with increasing stress and responsibility, turning tough feedback into growth.
Talent Management & Development: Recognizing potential in others, nurturing them, and acquiring the skills to create a 'learning culture' within the team.

details.intro: Aims not only for participants to understand measured competencies but also to convert them into behavioral evidence for effective performance.
bullets: Competency Awareness & Alignment: Deep analysis of competencies in the organization's leadership model and aligning them with the participant's own style.
Case Analysis & Strategic Problem-Solving: Developing skills to analyze complex business scenarios under time constraints and structure data-driven solutions.
Role-Play Simulations: Experiencing professional behavior patterns in difficult employee management, client meetings, or crisis scenarios.
Impact & Presentation Techniques: Delivering prepared solutions to senior management in a persuasive, confident, and structured manner.
Mental Preparation & Anxiety Management: Managing performance pressure and developing mental resilience focused on 'right behavior' rather than 'right answers'.

details.intro: Aims to elevate the coach's sessions to 'mastery' level and achieve success in both credentialing exams and performance evaluations.
bullets: In-Depth Competency Analysis: Ensuring ICF core competencies become a natural reflex within coaching sessions.
Audio Recording Analysis & Feedback: Analyzing real session recordings with 'Marker'-based concrete data.
Coaching Presence Development: Strengthening the coach's ability to remain in a state of 'not knowing' and use intuitions professionally during sessions.
Exam Preparation & Technical Support: Structuring credentialing application requirements and strategic preparation for the current ICF exam format.
Ethics & Professional Standards: Developing professional awareness by discussing the ethical rules of coaching through case analyses.

trainingArea.title: Training Programs
descriptions: The core purpose of this training program is to enable leaders to analyze their own experiences in a structured way without getting lost in the daily work tempo, transitioning from intuitive leadership to conscious leadership. This is a holistic leadership development program that aims not only for managers to acquire knowledge, but to experience behavioral transformation in real work environments.
Transforming leaders' management styles from a 'responding' model to an 'asking and provoking thought' model, building a learning and high-accountability culture in the organization.
Optimizing a team's potential along the axes of strategic clarity, relational trust, and agile execution to achieve sustainable high performance.
Equipping leaders with the ability to read the fundamental needs and motivation codes behind each individual's behaviors and develop management models suited to these codes.
Enabling participants to recognize the fundamental mechanisms in their communication processes and transform this awareness into a strategic influence power.
Building a high-performance corporate culture by increasing an organization's collective awareness, resilience, and relational quality.
Enabling participants to move from the 'busyness' trap to the 'effectiveness' level, becoming active architects of their own time.
Equipping managers with the ability to transform performance evaluation sessions into high-impact development dialogues that directly affect business results.
Ensuring systematic transfer of critical competencies to developing talents through experienced leaders (mentors) for the organization's strategic goals.
Enabling participants to transform feedback from a defense or attack mechanism into a development fuel.

details.intro: Participants in this journey strengthen their leadership mindset, deepen their core leadership competencies, and gain practical tools to drive their teams to high performance. Leaders are supported with one-on-one coaching sessions throughout the program.
bullets: Adopting a Coaching Approach: Enabling leaders to recognize patterns and blind spots in their own decisions, reaching holistic leadership mastery that manages self, people, and performance simultaneously, creates impact through coaching approach, builds trust and commitment, has the courage to hold difficult conversations, and transforms their team into a self-managing structure.

Mastering Competencies: The Leader's Logbook doesn't develop leadership competencies one by one; it strengthens the leader's entire leadership capacity simultaneously. Transforming into a mastered leader whose compass is clear, who instills confidence in their team, who opens directions rather than pointing them, and who grows capacity rather than solving problems.
Emotional & Mental Clarity: Helping leaders clear their minds, clarify their priorities, and maintain their inner balance under intense data flow and stress.
Values & Vision Alignment: Regularly checking how the leader's daily actions align with their long-term vision and personal values to reinforce 'authentic leadership' posture.
Continuous Development Tracking: Monitoring progress in identified leadership competencies with concrete examples and turning development from mere intention into an evidence-based journey.

details.intro: Aims to base the leader's influence on a trust-based growth relationship rather than hierarchical power, triggering sustainable high performance.
bullets: Mindset Transformation: Shedding micro-management habits to become a 'coach leader' who trusts employees.
Converting Potential to Performance: Guiding employees to recognize their existing competencies and triggering their intrinsic motivation.
Questioning & Listening Discipline: Masterfully applying strategic questioning techniques that enable employees to find their own solutions.
Continuous Feedback & Development Culture: Transforming performance management into 'instant coaching' sessions integrated into daily interactions.
Empowerment & Delegation: Spreading leadership responsibility by providing coaching support for employees to gain competency and confidence.

details.intro: A dynamic guidance process that analyzes the team's current state and provides a concrete roadmap to close the gap with its target (North Star).
bullets: North Star (Common Vision) Setting: Clarifying the team's reason for existence and priority strategic goals to ensure all members focus on the same vision.
Values & Trust Foundation: Creating a foundation where team members are confident in each other's intentions and psychological safety is ensured.
Role & Responsibility Clarity: Ending authority confusion and crystallizing each member's value to the team.
Communication & Decision Navigation: Establishing rules for information flow and increasing operational speed.
Continuous Development & Adaptation: Gaining the ability to recalibrate according to changing conditions; creating a learning team culture.

details.intro: Moves beyond the 'same reward for everyone' mentality, offering a scientific and psychological approach that synchronizes individual passions with organizational goals.
bullets: Motivational Profiling: Using analytical tools and observation techniques to accurately diagnose employees' motivation codes.
Personalizing Communication & Influence Language: Developing a communication language suited to each employee's 'hearing and action' code to maximize persuasion.
Igniting the Inner Fuel: Opening intrinsic motivation channels that address the employee's need for 'meaning', 'mastery', and 'autonomy' in their work.
Team Energy & Harmony: Transforming the differences of individuals with different motivation codes into a synergistic force.
High Engagement & Performance Sustainability: Creating an ecosystem where employees know 'why' they work, reducing turnover.

details.intro: Centers on 'creating shared meaning' rather than just 'sending messages', aiming to build a transparent, productive, and trust-based interaction architecture.
bullets: Analyzing Hidden Layers: Developing the ability to manage the real message created by tone of voice, micro-expressions, and body language beyond words.
Decoding Listening: Moving from 'listening to respond' to 'listening to understand and feel', building genuine connections.
Perception & Filter Management: Recognizing individuals' 'communication filters' and learning techniques to deliver messages without them getting stuck.
Psychological Safety & Transparency: Developing open communication protocols where information flows with trust; building a language based on facts rather than assumptions.
Influence & Persuasion Genetics: Understanding the decision-making codes of the other person and structuring messages most effectively.

details.intro: Treats emotional intelligence principles not just as an individual competency but as a strategic management discipline, aiming to increase the organization's adaptation speed to changes.
bullets: Emotional Culture Design: Analyzing 'invisible rules' within the organization and creating a work environment built on trust, appreciation, and transparency.
Organizational Empathy & Customer Focus: Building value-creating relationships by correctly reading emotional data in interactions with external stakeholders and customers.
Collective Resilience: Developing systemic mechanisms to transform crisis and uncertainty moments into learning and strengthening opportunities.
Conflict Management & Psychological Safety: Establishing a trust environment where different ideas can be freely expressed and constructive conflict feeds innovation.
EQ-Based Leadership Pipeline: Building a consistent chain of management practices with a common emotional language across all management levels.

details.intro: Combines neuroscientific approaches and strategic planning techniques to structure limited time for maximum meaning and output.
bullets: From Reactive to Proactive: Achieving the mental transformation that enables leaders to set their own strategic agenda instead of chasing daily crises.
Cognitive Energy & Focus Management: Recognizing that time is managed with energy and attention, maximizing mental performance with 'Deep Work' sessions.
Prioritization Architecture: Making it a life discipline to lower the noise of what's 'urgent' and amplify the voice of what's 'important'.
Digital & Physical Space Design: Structurally managing digital noise that sabotages focus and establishing work routines that support flow state.
Life Balance & Sustainability: Creating a time design that prevents burnout by integrating professional success with personal renewal and quality of life.

details.intro: Aims for the manager to reach a negotiation mastery that blends objective data analysis with emotional intelligence, developing the employee without putting them on the defensive.
bullets: Psychological Safety & Environment Design: Establishing the conversation on a safe, transparent, and constructive ground; creating a climate where feedback is perceived as a reward.
Evidence-Based & Objective Evaluation: Developing a feedback language based on concrete achievements and observable behaviors to reinforce fairness.
Mastery in Challenging Dialogues: Experiencing how to discuss underperformance while maintaining professional boundaries without compromising message clarity.
Future Focus: Structuring 'feedforward' techniques and development plans instead of focusing on past mistakes.
Commitment & Action Alignment: Creating a consensus ground where the employee fully understands, owns, and feels supported in new goals.

details.intro: Going beyond theoretical knowledge, aims to transform lived experiences, organizational awareness, and application skills into lasting behavioral change.
bullets: Closing Competency Gaps: Strengthening development areas through concrete projects and on-the-job learning under the mentor's guidance.
Experiential Learning & Wisdom Transfer: Accelerating the mentee's learning curve by sharing the mentor's career lessons and insights.
Organizational Memory & Culture Preservation: Transferring the organization's unwritten rules and values to the mentee to reinforce belonging.
Career Navigation & Networking: Increasing the mentee's visibility within the organization and serving as a strategic mirror in their career journey.
Bilateral Development: Positioning the mentoring process as a development opportunity for the mentor as well.

details.intro: Targeting mastery in both 'giving' and 'receiving' feedback, aiming to create a cultural foundation that supports transparent, honest, and continuous learning within the organization.
bullets: Giving Mastery: Developing the ability to deliver feedback in a professional language focused on observable behaviors and concrete business results rather than personal judgment.
Receiving Mastery: Developing the maturity to see incoming feedback as 'valuable data' rather than a 'threat'.
SBI & Feedforward Models: Providing clarity with the Situation-Behavior-Impact flow and internalizing 'Feedforward' techniques that design future performance.
Psychological Safety Building: Establishing an environment where feedback creates trust; enabling team members to request feedback with sincerity.
Illuminating Blind Spots: Using others' observations as a mirror to surface behavior patterns that hinder performance.

items.question: What areas do your coaching services cover?
items.answer: Our coaching services cover C-Level leadership coaching, team coaching, executive coaching, assessment preparation coaching, credentialing coaching and mentoring, as well as professional coaching training program instruction.

items.question: What topics are your training programs offered in?
items.answer: Our training programs are offered in a wide range of topics including management and leadership skills, effective people management, change management, motivation, the art of feedback, teamwork, emotional intelligence, stress management, time management, meeting management, communication skills, problem solving and decision making, customer focus and strategy management.

items.question: Are your services individual or corporate?
items.answer: We serve both individual and corporate clients. We offer customized solutions tailored to each client's needs, designing personalized programs for both individuals and organizations.

items.question: How does the coaching process work?
items.answer: Our coaching process begins with understanding the client's needs. Then a customized coaching plan is created and progress is tracked through regular sessions. Throughout the process, measurements and techniques ensure the best feedback and action plans are created.

items.question: Are your training programs online or in-person?
items.answer: Our training programs can be delivered in both online and in-person formats. The most suitable format is selected according to the client's preference and needs.

items.question: Do you have coaching certifications?
items.answer: Yes, our founder Nurhan Yazganel holds the MCC (Master Certified Coach) title approved by ICF (International Coach Federation) and the Senior Practitioner title approved by EMCC (European Mentoring & Coaching Council). She also has over 8,000 hours of coaching experience.

items.question: What industries do you have experience in?
items.answer: We have served over 300 companies in various sectors including automotive, finance, technology, healthcare, retail, chemicals, textiles, energy, logistics and many more.

items.question: How can I get in touch?
items.answer: You can fill out the form on our contact page or send an email directly to info@corecoachingtraining.com. We typically respond within 24 hours on business days.
